articles.title: Peggy Carter Getting 'Frisbeed to Death' in Doctor Strange Was 'A Complete Disservice,' Hayley Atwell Says
articles.summary: Peggy Carter's untimely demise in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness was a "complete disservice to the character," Marvel actress Hayley Atwell has said.
articles.body:
After years of waiting to become a superhero herself, Peggy Carter's untimely demise in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness was a "complete disservice to the character," Marvel actress Hayley Atwell has said.

Speaking at the For the Love of Fantasy & Sci-Fi convention in London this weekend, Atwell said that she had tried to pitch alternate versions of her character's fight to the death against Elizabeth Olsen's Wanda Maximoff/Scarlet Witch, only for her suggestions to be ignored.

Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness features an alternate version of Peggy Carter who has become Captain Carter, and wields a version of Captain America's shield that sports a Union Jack logo. Sadly, alongside the rest of her Illuminati (Illumi-what-y?) team, she is quickly wiped out by Wanda.

Marvel Cinematic Universe: Every Upcoming Movie and TV Show

"I loved the idea that she'd be in the suit and have the shield," Atwell began. "And if I'm really brutally honest, I was so disappointed with how they positioned her and what happened to her in that scene. It's so small, and she gets frisbeed to death."

Of course, the point of her character's presence in the movie is to demonstrate Wanda's power and to show how far the former Avenger has fallen as she wipes out a team of heroes, including Carter, John Krasinski's Mr. Fantastic, and Patrick Stewart's Professor X.

But it's also true that Atwell gets just a handful of lines before Wanda appears and kills them all within seconds. There's a fun moment where Carter gets to quote Steve Rogers' classic "I could do this all day" line, but, seconds later, Wanda sends Captain Carter's shield bouncing back into the heroine's gut, with the suggestion she has been bisected completely.

Atwell says it was the quoting of Steve Rogers' dialogue that particularly irked her, as the obvious response was then "no you couldn't [do this all day]," prompting the feeling that actually she was just "lame."

"I felt that was like a bum steer and a complete disservice to the character," Atwell added. "I tried on set to kind of go, 'Can I just add? Can I just suggest?' And they were like, 'Sure, but no.'"

Atwell will next return to the franchise in Avengers: Doomsday, and it'll be interested to see where the character goes next. Will there be a chance for Carter to suit up again, or will she be left at home holding the baby? (Even if it is the latter, this is probably preferable to Doctor Doom holding it instead.) Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theaters on December 18, and Marvel has put together a list of MCU movies and TV shows you should watch before it arrives .

Image credit: Bryan Bedder/Getty Images for Paramount Pictures.

Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

articles.title: Billie Piper Says She's 'Not the Next Doctor' After That Bizarre Doctor Who Cliffhanger, Asks Fans to 'Chill Out'
articles.summary: Billie Piper has finally discussed her bizarre Doctor Who cliffhanger, and said "everyone needs to chill out and wait" while the show is on hiatus.
articles.body:
Billie Piper has finally discussed her bizarre Doctor Who cliffhanger, and said "everyone needs to chill out and wait" while the show is on hiatus.

Piper appeared in the closing seconds of last season following the regeneration of Ncuti Gatwa's Doctor, though exactly who she was playing was left deliberately unclear. Was she the Doctor's next regeneration, or a version of her previous character, the beloved companion Rose Tyler?

Speculation around her appearance was fuelled by reports that it was a last-minute addition to the series, amid uncertainty over its future. Indeed, the finale's last third consisted of scenes added in reshoots, as Gatwa had quit the show and required some form of exit sequence.

Now, more than a year on, Doctor Who's future seems no more secure. The BBC has said it will put the franchise's production up for tender, a process in which external companies can bid to make the series. However, several more months have passed since this announcement, and last week Doctor Who writer Mark Gatiss stated that the series' return would "quietly won't happen" as it now needed to be rested.

The 25 Most Essential Doctor Who Episodes

With all this in mind, it's no wonder that Piper was quizzed about her future in Doctor Who at this weekend's For the Love of Fantasy & Sci-Fi convention in London. And while the actress remained fairly tight-lipped, she did confirm that she was "not the next Doctor" in waiting.

"I am not the next Doctor, I am Rose Tyler in hiatus," Piper said. "Sorry that's a really cryptic answer but because I'm not currently filming Doctor Who as the Doctor I can't lie and say otherwise. I'm sweating, I hate this.

"I think you've all gotta be very patient," she continued. "It'll be worth it when it comes. I think what we need to celebrate is the show the fact has been on air for 26 years, the new incarnation. It's been around a very long time, it's massively successful and it's impacted so many people's lives positively. It's had a bit of a rough time lately and I think everyone needs to chill out and wait for what comes from having this space and time."

Piper mentioning the show's recent "rough time" appears to be a reference to the series' production struggles in the wake of previous co-funding partner Disney losing interest in the show, in the wake of middling ratings and criticism of its quality. Showrunner Russell T. Davies and existing production company Bad Wolf both confirmed they would no longer be part of the series' future earlier this year, at the same time as the BBC confirmed its intention to put the series out to tender.

A previous report by Deadline suggested there was now hesitation among production companies to take on Doctor Who , despite — or perhaps because of — its legendary status. "You would have to be mad," one source said. "[It's a] bit of a nightmare for any producer in this market with the shadow of the Disney fallout ," said another. A third suggested the series' budget would likely be around $3 million per episode — half of the budget for the episodes Disney previously funded, inviting difficult comparisons.

All of which tallies with comments from former Doctor Who Magazine editor Tom Spilsbury, who last year suggested it would likely be "five or six years before we see anything new," as the series' next incarnation is determined. "At which point, it will be the children of 2005 who will be bringing the show back, just as Russell predicted. As ever, time will tell."

Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

articles.title: Former Rockstar Dev Calls GTA 6 Leaks 'A Nothing Burger,' Insists Hot Coffee Was Much, Much Worse
articles.summary: As Take-Two works to identify the person or group behind the GTA 6 'CyberLeek' account, one former Rockstar developer has insisted the recent spate of gameplay leaks will have little impact on the success of the game itself.
articles.body:
As Take-Two works to identify the person or group behind the GTA 6 'CyberLeek' account, one former Rockstar developer has insisted the recent spate of gameplay leaks will have little impact on the success of the game itself.

CyberLeek has released 10 GTA 6 gameplay videos and an image of the full map in the space of just six days , sparking a manhunt for the people responsible. Rockstar parent company Take-Two has subpoenaed Microsoft, Discord, and even X / Twitter, but the leaker appears undeterred, and is even running a crypto-fueled poll to determine which video to release next.

All this just a week before Netflix’s timed-exclusive reveal of GTA 6, which is set to fully unveil the game officially for the first time.

Every Detail in the GTA 6 Cover Art Explained

From a Take-Two and Rockstar perspective, significant damage is being done. According to Bloomberg , Rockstar still doesn’t know how these leaks happened, nor who is behind them. And while there are no plans to shift this week’s big Netflix reveal, Bloomberg reported that there is frustration and anger internally at recent events, with management sending morale-boosting emails to staff.

Former Rockstar Games technical director Obbe Vermeij, however, downplayed the damage caused by the leaks. Vermeij, who worked at Rockstar North from 1995 to 2009, took to social media to say the Hot Coffee scandal was much more damaging than these GTA 6 leaks.

“Calm down everybody. The leaks are a nothing burger,” Vermeij began.

“As a marketing strategy R* is trying to keep the game under wraps longer than other publishers. All that has happened is that some footage has escaped. Slightly ahead of the Netflix thing next week.

“90% of future players don’t spend their time on the internet looking for video snippets. They don’t have the time and don’t want spoilers.

“I imagine the teams are a little annoyed about it but not more than that. I was there during Hot Coffee. It was a nightmare for management (R*NewYork) but didn’t affect us (R*North) much. The current leaks are far less consequential than HC was.

“It looks like GTA 6 will be phenomenal and sell for the next 15 years or so. The leaks are just a tiny blip.”

The Hot Coffee scandal was a 2005 controversy involving a hidden, sexually explicit mini-game inside Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. Modders discovered that unfinished code left on game discs allowed players to unlock a crude, interactive sex scene, leading to political outrage, a temporary "Adults Only" rating, and multimillion-dollar settlements for Rockstar Games.

“No, it really hurt,” Vermeij said of Hot Coffee. “The game had to be withdrawn from stores in the USA. It could only be sold as 18+ until the new version was ready. It is estimated to have cost $50 million which was a lot of money for R*/T2 at the time.”

Speaking to Lex Fridman in October last year , Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser said the company “nearly imploded several times due to Hot Coffee,” adding: “It was extremely tough.”

There is growing concern that CyberLeek may spoil the GTA 6 story by releasing plot-critical cutscenes. So far, that hasn’t happened, but even if it did, Vermeij downplayed the impact. “That would suck but people will still play it,” he said.

There is also speculation that CyberLeek has a working build of GTA 6, based on some of the gameplay shown in the leaks. “If that is the case it probably only runs on a devkit,” Vermeij insisted. “Devkits have more memory. There probably isn't a build in existence that would run on a retail PS5 at the moment.”

GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, setting records for sales and revenue. As Vermeij says, the gameplay leaks are unlikely to threaten the success of the game's November launch. But they remain part of what is a significant security breach for Take-Two and Rockstar, one that will no doubt affect the morale of staff who have spent years building the game. They also potentially dampen the impact of the timed-exclusive reveal on Netflix, which I imagine isn't thrilled by what's going on.

Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has issued a statement on the GTA 6 leaks. IGN has asked for comment.

Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: ESPN Unlimited Is Celebrating Its First Anniversary With a Price Hike
articles.summary: ESPN Unlimited and ESPN Select are getting price hikes next month, making one Disney+ bundle more valuable than ever.
articles.body:
According to a support page on ESPN’s website , both ESPN Select and ESPN Unlimited are getting price hikes.

Starting September 17, ESPN Unlimited plans will be increasing by $2, while ESPN Select plans get a smaller $1 hike. The ESPN increases will also affect the price of the existing Disney+ bundle with ESPN Select, though ESPN Unlimited bundles will seemingly retain the same monthly pricing.

ESPN Price Hike Taking Effect September 17

ESPN Unlimited first launched almost exactly a year ago, in August 2025. The service was pitched as a particularly inclusive sports streaming service in an otherwise complicated landscape of divided licenses and leagues. ESPN Select launched at the same time to functionally replace ESPN+, with existing subscribers automatically moved over to the new plan.

ESPN has admittedly grown its content offerings since that initial launch. MLB.tv was moved to the ESPN app starting with the 2026 season, and a sublicensing deal with The CW expanded the service’s roster of college sports . More recently, ESPN acquired NFL media assets , and the NFL Network just became available to Unlimited plan subscribers on July 30.

Disney+ increased its own prices by a similar $2 margin last October . For its standalone plans, ESPN is following a similar approach of announcing the hike several weeks before it goes into effect for both new and returning subscribers, giving potential “new” customers an extra incentive to sign up before then.

Unlike the standalone ESPN plans, the price increase on the Disney+ bundle with ESPN Select has already gone into effect for new subscribers. The fact that the price increase doesn’t seem to be touching the ESPN Unlimited bundles increases the “value” of those bundles, assuming subscribers would already be interested in all three services.

It’s also worth nothing that the price hike trend extends far beyond the Disney ecosystem. Paramount+ and Netflix both announced price hikes earlier this year, while Peacock just increased its own streaming plan prices for the fourth time in four years. Will there ever be an endpoint to the price hikes? Here’s to hoping.

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who, when she isn't following streaming news, spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Pokémon Collector Poses as Buyer to Recover $4,000 Worth of Stolen Cards in 'Vigilante' Sting Operation
articles.summary: Canadian collector Emilio Kihien took matters into his own hands after police said they “couldn’t do much” to help him recover $4,000 worth of stolen Pokemon cards.
articles.body:
Canadian collector Emilio Kihien took matters into his own hands after police said they “couldn’t do much” to help him recover $4,000 worth of stolen Pokémon cards.

Kihien was conducting what he thought was a standard sale for a few highly-graded, officially-encapsulated Pokémon trading cards at his home in Coquitlam when the buyers handed him $4,000 in phony bills, snatched the goods, and ran. Kihien gave chase, even hanging onto the side of the thieves’ getaway car before falling onto the road, suffering bruising and a painful bout of road rash as a result.

His next step was to contact police — but he says authorities told him they “couldn’t do much” to help him recover his stolen property. According to Kihien, one officer even told him it’d be better to try and catch the culprits himself.

We Build LEGO Pokémon Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise

“The police response — they really didn’t seem like they were gonna help me that much. One of the officers literally said, ‘If it was me, I’d probably just try to set them up myself,’" he told local outlet CTV News .

A few days later, one of Kihien’s buddies came across a listing for the stolen cards online. The thieves even used the exact same images Kihien had included in his original posting.

“I’m just thinking, you know what, these guys can’t be the most intelligent of people,” he remarked.

Acting quickly, Kihien and his friends posed as interested buyers, and set up an exchange at the Metropolis at Metrotown in Burnaby on August 13, where they detained the alleged thieves until police arrived. Reports state one adult and one juvenile were detained, who could face criminal charges including theft.

Kihien recorded the entire ordeal on his smart glasses, showing himself and his friends blocking the suspects from leaving the Barnaby mall. And while their sting operation proved successful, police are urging future victims of theft against such measures.

“Vigilantism can only cause problems,” Royal Canadian Mounted Police Corporal Mike Kalanj said. “No one knows who has weapons. Even as the victim, if you show up and you harm someone, now you’re looking at charges, as well.”

The stolen cards went mostly unharmed, though one case was cracked in the altercations. The haul included three 2023 Pokémon Mew EN Special Illustration Rare EX cards (for Blastoise, Venusaur, and Charizard), graded a PSA 10 — meaning the agency could find no flaws with them , whatsoever.

This is the latest Pokémon TCG crime to make headlines after a pair of thieves in Britain were locked up for making off with £71,000 ($95,000) worth of stock after their getaway van broke down in July.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

Kihien recorded the entire ordeal on his smart glasses, showing himself and his friends blocking the suspects from leaving the Barnaby mall. And while their sting operation proved successful, police are urging future victims of theft against such measures.

“Vigilantism can only cause problems,” Royal Canadian Mounted Police Corporal Mike Kalanj said. “No one knows who has weapons. Even as the victim, if you show up and you harm someone, now you’re looking at charges, as well.”

The stolen cards went mostly unharmed, though one case was cracked in the altercations. The haul included three 2023 Pokémon Mew EN Special Illustration Rare EX cards (for Blastoise, Venusaur, and Charizard), graded a PSA 10 — meaning the agency could find no flaws with them , whatsoever.

This is the latest Pokémon TCG crime to make headlines after a pair of thieves in Britain were locked up for making off with £71,000 ($95,000) worth of stock after their getaway van broke down in July.

articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Adds New Dynamic Cosmetic Options for Certain Characters Like Ghost
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is adding more options for how your operators appear in-game.
articles.body:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is adding more options for how your operators appear in-game.

The recently released Modern Warfare 4 beta has given players their first look at a ton of features, maps, and other content that will be available in the final game. Some of these things were heavily advertised before launch, such as the fluidity of movement and a new system that randomly generates gun builds for you.

One feature that was kept under wraps, however, allows players to equip different cosmetic items on the fly in-game. Ghost, for instance, can remove his mask (which comically reveals another cloth mask underneath) and put it back on. Valeria can equip a hockey mask. And Captain Price can smoke a cigar, which will appear on-screen in first-person at all times unless you take it out.

You Can Remove Ghost's Mask in Modern Warfare 4 using the NEW 'Operator Variant' Feature in the Emote Wheel: pic.twitter.com/ABJma6tvsy — DETONATED (@DETONATEDcom) August 23, 2026

You Can Remove Ghost's Mask in Modern Warfare 4 using the NEW 'Operator Variant' Feature in the Emote Wheel: pic.twitter.com/ABJma6tvsy

this is the best MW4 mastercraft the cigar actually stays in ur mouth until you respawn lol pic.twitter.com/sFWQUrV02k — B23 (@B23COD) August 21, 2026

this is the best MW4 mastercraft the cigar actually stays in ur mouth until you respawn lol pic.twitter.com/sFWQUrV02k

It's a fun touch and one that will almost certainly be taken advantage of in premium skins. As of right now, we're not sure what skins to expect in MW4, but Call of Duty has promised to keep things more grounded after fan backlash to previous games. Specifically, they said there will be "no Lady Gaga. No Omni-Man. No Teletubbies. No SpongeBob."

The fan reception on Modern Warfare 4's beta has been fairly divisive so far. Some fear that the game is a bit too fast, especially for having relatively small maps. The time-to-kill is extremely rapid, but Infinity Ward has addressed much of this feedback from fans so far. The studio has released patches for the beta addressing TTK, spawns, and is also looking to make improvements to the gunsmith system for launch.

IGN spoke with some of MW4's multiplayer leads last week ahead of the beta, and they made it clear this playtest is essential in helping shape the final game. "To me, this beta feels like the start of the conversation with the public, you know what I mean? We're excited to basically put that out there and we'll see what happens next. We want to just keep talking and keep learning and trying to find out what we can do better," said Jackie Reynolds, Modern Warfare 4's multiplayer design lead.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: You Can Now Build a LEGO Millennium Pumpkin Ahead of Halloween
articles.body:
The LEGO community has long enjoyed the process of taking a seemingly normal set and turning it into the iconic Star Wars ship. LEGO has released a total of 12 official versions of the Millennium Falcon over the years, but one fan has taken it even further and created 19 alternate builds himself.

Brad Barber, known on Reddit as Minute_Food_2881, has made headlines before for his unique builds. You may recognize his name from the cursed Millennium Simba set last year. His most recent recreation utilizes the new LEGO Halloween Pumpkin Lantern that just released this August.

My Millennium Pumpkin alternate build of the 40872 Pumpkin Lantern. by u/Minute_Food_2881 in lego

Unlike some of Barber's previous MOCs (My Own Creation), the Millennium Pumpkin has the added benefit of actually lighting up. The Halloween Pumpkin Lantern set includes a light brick that would normally only be activated by pressing the stem. According to Barber, the Millenium Pumpkin will also activate when you place it on the stand.

Like other alternate builds Barber has created, this version of the Falcon can be created entirely with pieces from the original set. The Halloween Pumpkin Lantern set includes a light brick which will shine forward when activated. All-in-all, it's an impressively spooky alternative to an actual Star Wars-themed build. The set is available at the LEGO Store for $29.99 and you can grab instructions for Barber's Millennium Falcon version from Rebrickable for $3 more .

Set #40872 is currently a LEGO Exclusive which means you can only buy it at the LEGO Store. That's generally the best place to buy LEGO sets , but because the price is under $30, it's not eligible for any of the gifts with purchase available now.

articles.title: Vampire Hunter D Returns: The Cult-Classic Horror Series Finds New Life in 2026
articles.summary: With a new Western comic book series in the works and a theatrical rerelease slated for 2027, the Vampire Hunter D franchise is suddenly back in the spotlight.
articles.body:
Vampire Hunter D is a franchise that has enjoyed a long, healthy lifespan as a series of Japanese light novels, but has never really been explored to its fullest in other media. The last Vampire Hunter D film to be released was 2001's Vampire Hunter D: Bloodlust. Luckily for fans of the wandering hero known only as D, there's been some new momentum surrounding the franchise recently, including both a brand-new Western comics series and a theatrical rerelease.

First up, Dark Horse Comics is releasing a new miniseries called Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood. The series isn't an adaptation of one of Hideyuki Kikuchi's novels, but is rather an original story set in that post-apocalyptic universe. Fortress of Blood is written by Chris Condon (That Texas Blood) and illustrated by Filipe Andrade (The Many Deaths of Laila Starr).

Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood #1 Cover Art Gallery

The creative team also includes colorist Jordie Bellaire and letterer Frank Cvetkovic. Andrade illustrated the main cover for issue #1, with variants by Riccardo Federici and Yoshitaka Amano. Here's Dark Horse's official summary of the first issue:

The first official comic series based on Hideyuki Kikuchi’s Vampire Hunter D! A vampire lord has marshalled his forces and is marching on human settlements aiming to leave no survivors! One thing stands among his path to the next city—the old fortress. There, a family of outcasts will need to buy enough time for the humans to flee. And wandering this same path is the beautiful, indomitable hunter—half-human, half-vampire—known as D.

Vampire Hunter D: Fortress of Blood #1 will be released on December 16. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .

On the film front, GKIDS revealed that Bloodlust is getting a theatrical rerelease in 2027, just after the film's 25th anniversary.

GKIDS is proud to announce the acquisition of North American rights to VAMPIRE HUNTER D: BLOODLUST. 🩸 The rarely-screened gothic horror classic from Yoshiaki Kawajiri and MADHOUSE will get a full theatrical release in 2027. More details soon! https://t.co/UAi0WXpGqN pic.twitter.com/jTfCJ7qDWl — GKIDS Films (@GKIDSfilms) August 22, 2026

GKIDS is proud to announce the acquisition of North American rights to VAMPIRE HUNTER D: BLOODLUST. 🩸 The rarely-screened gothic horror classic from Yoshiaki Kawajiri and MADHOUSE will get a full theatrical release in 2027. More details soon! https://t.co/UAi0WXpGqN pic.twitter.com/jTfCJ7qDWl

There are no further details regarding a release date or possible 4k Blu-ray release, but hopefully Bloodlust returning to theaters will spark new interest in the series and pave the way for another film or anime series. Previously, an anime called Vampire Hunter D: Resurrection was announced in 2015, but work on the series seemingly stalled out during the COVID-19 pandemic.

For more on this cult-favorite franchise, check out IGN's Hidden Treasures retrospective on Vampire Hunter D .

articles.title: These Huge One-Volume History Books Are on Sale for $0.99 Each
articles.summary: Two major one-volume history books published by Penguin are on sale for $0.99 each. The deal ends soon.
articles.body:
Heads up, amateur historians: here’s an incredible deal on two beefy tomes for your digital bookshelf. Penguin is running $0.99 sales on the Kindle ebook version of two of its biggest history books. The latest editions of The Penguin History of the World ( see at Amazon ) and The Penguin History of the United States of America ( see on Amazon ) are both on sale for $0.99 each . The sale ends tonight, so grab ‘em if you want to learn a thing or two for super cheap.

The Penguin History of the World: 6th Edition (Kindle Ebook)

The Penguin History of the World is currently in its 6th edition. It’s been a landmark book ever since J.M. Roberts published the first edition in 1976. Roberts was a renowned and popular British historian who updated the book many times over the ensuing decades until his death in 2003. At that point, Penguin brought on the wonderfully named historian Odd Arne Westad to continue editing and revising the tome. In physical form, it’s a doorstopper of a book, ringing in at 1,280 pages. If you grab this deal, the math works out to roughly $0.00077 per page.

The Penguin History of the United States of America: New Edition (Kindle Ebook)

As for The Penguin History of the USA, it was first published in 1985 as The Longman History of the United States of America. It’s by Hugh Brogan , a British historian and biographer who, it so happens, used to correspond regularly with J.R.R. Tolkien. In fact, a number of Tokien's letters to Brogan are included in The Letters of J.R.R. Tolkien ( see at Amazon ). Anyway, this book kicks off in 30,000 BCE, when it’s thought the first humans may have come over the land-bridge that’s now the Bering Strait, and runs up to the Reagan era of the 1980s.

If you’re like me and you’re not exactly a history buff , but you’re generally interested history as a concept, it can be hard to find good books to read. Most history books, after all, hone in on one time period, or one major historical event. That’s how historians (and most academics and professionals, for that matter) work: they specialize. But if you want a broad overview of all of human history? Or of the history of the United States? Decent one-volume books on those broad topics, that cover that much history, are a bit harder to find.

Penguin’s pair of history books are some of the most popular, and have been for decades. They go in chronological order, so you can follow the broad arc of history over centuries or millennia.

Again, the deals won’t last forever. There’s actually a ticking clock on the page for the USA history book; that deal ends at midnight Pacific Time. As for the History of the World, that one doesn’t have so definite an end, but you can bet it won’t be a buck forever, so add it to your Kindle library sooner than later if you’re interested.

Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN. He also runs IGN's board game and LEGO coverage. You can follow him on Bluesky .

articles.title: Persona Comes to Beard Papa's With Special 30th Anniversary Collaboration
articles.summary: Beard Papa’s is teaming up with Persona to celebrate the RPG series’ 30th anniversary with some special cream puffs.
articles.body:
Beard Papa’s is teaming up with Persona to celebrate the RPG series’ 30th anniversary with some special cream puffs.

Beard Papa’s is a Japanese dessert chain with locations sprinkled across the US. It’s best known for its primary offering, cream puffs, which come in a variety of different flavors and combinations for customers to choose from.

Starting September 4, participating Beard Papa’s locations within the United States will transform their interiors and offer up several new flavors of cream puffs in collaboration with Persona.

Persona 4 Revival Release Date Trailer Xbox Games Showcase 2026 - Screenshots

These storefronts will feature Persona-themed digital menu boards, bakery case graphics, posters, television displays, and more, transforming them into a real-life Persona menu screen. And for mega-fans, the Beard Papa’s locations in Little Tokyo and Cerritos will include large-format anniversary murals specifically designed for photo opportunities.

Limited-time cream puff flavors are also on offer: Original Cream Puff, Matcha Cream Puff, Ube S'mores Cream Puff, Cookies & Cream Cream Puff, and the Double Berry Cream Puff, each inspired by specific games in the Persona series.

Four and six-pack gift sets are also available for purchase. The four-pack set comes with four featured cream puffs, a Persona chibi sticker sheet, and an in-game code card for Persona 5: The Phantom X. The six-pack set comes with six cream puffs, a blind-packed acrylic standee featuring one of eight designs, and an in-game code card for Persona 5: The Phantom X.

Of course, it wouldn’t be a collab if there wasn’t merchandise involved; you can also snag a ceramic mug, a T-shirt, zip hoodie, and eco tote bag as part of the Persona x Beard Papa’s partnership on the official Beard Papa’s website .

This collaboration lasts from September 4 to October 4, just in time to herald the next big developments for the Persona series. Persona 4 Revival, a full remake of Persona 4 Golden, is set to release in February 2027 , and Atlus is hard at work on the next entry in the franchise, Persona 6.

It’s a big time for Persona; a live-action adaptation is in the works at Netflix, with Christopher Monfette attached as writer, showrunner, and executive producer. 21 Laps' Shawn Levy and Robert Atwood are also attached to executive produce, alongside Sega’s Toru Nakahara.

Beyond that, Kazuhisa Wada, producer for Atlus' P-Studio, recently remarked that he believes the studio will “have to” do remakes of the first and second games in the Persona series, giving fans even more to look forward to as the days tick down to Persona 4 Revival’s release.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.title: The Simpsons Parodies Black Mirror in New Disney+ Special
articles.summary: Ahead of the Season 38 premiere, The Simpsons is returning to Disney+ for a special episode that lampoons Black Mirror. Check out our exclusive preview of "Yellow Mirror."
articles.body:
The Simpsons will soon return for a mind-boggling 38th Season on Fox. But if you can't wait that long, you're in luck. The series is about to drop its latest exclusive episode on Disney+, and we've got an exclusive early look.

Check out the slideshow gallery below to see exclusive new images from "Yellow Mirror":

The Simpsons: "Yellow Mirror" Image Gallery

"Yellow Mirror" isn't the first Simpsons special to be exclusive to Disney+, but it is notable for being a full-length episode rather than a short in the vein of "The Simpsons in Plusaversary." As the title suggests, this episode acts as a spoof of Netflix's popular sci-fi anthology series Black Mirror. It features two tales linked by a common dystopian technology theme.

Here's the official description for "Yellow Mirror":

A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre in this Disney+ exclusive.

"Yellow Mirror" will premiere on Disney+ on Wednesday, August 26.

In other The Simpsons news, Bart Simpson voice actress Nancy Cartwright believes the series will ultimately end with Season 40 . The show also recently returned to Fortnite, where fans could collect a Simpsons-style John Wick skin .

Fans were also recently given new hope about the long-awaited return of The Simpsons: Hit & Run , with Matt Groening saying, "I think the original game is coming back in some form."

articles.title: Avengers: Endgame Re-Release Reveals New Iron Man and Infinity Gauntlet Popcorn Buckets, Tickets On Sale Now
articles.summary: The upcoming re-release of Avengers: Endgame will coincide with the debut of two flashy new popcorn buckets.
articles.body:
The upcoming re-release of Avengers: Endgame will coincide with the debut of two flashy new popcorn buckets.

In 2019, Avengers: Endgame was released, but this was just before the big popcorn bucket craze. Now, every movie needs to have an absurd, expensive popcorn bucket themed after something in the film. The upcoming re-release of the MCU film will allow fans the chance to purchase an Iron Man helmet popcorn bucket or one based on Iron Man's version of the Infinity Gauntlet, which he uses to sacrifice himself and kill Thanos. The Iron Man helmet also projects a message that reads, "I love you 3,000."

Tickets are now on sale for the Avengers: Endgame re-release. The film hits theaters on September 25 and will include roughly five minutes of new footage , which will lead directly into Avengers: Doomsday . Marvel is keeping a tight lid on what exactly this new footage will feature, but it may introduce Doctor Doom or tee up what happens with Captain America after his "happy ending" in Endgame. Chris Evans is set to reprise his role as Steve Rogers in Doomsday and most likely Avengers: Secret Wars, as well.

Marvel is also boasting its new "Infinity Vision" branding for the re-release of Endgame . Avengers: Doomsday will not be getting an IMAX release when it debuts in December, so Marvel and Disney created a marketing initative known as Infinity Vision which will help promote the most "ideal" theaters for the film. It's not a new format, but a certification that elevates auditoriums that meet a quality standard held by Disney and Marvel.

Avengers: Endgame's re-release will allow fans to take advantage of Infinity Vision screens, but it will be released in IMAX, too. There's a chance that Doomsday will still get an IMAX release , as Spider-Man: Brand New Day got a delayed IMAX release and it wasn't promoted ahead of time. It led to viewers going back for repeat viewings, and it wouldn't be surprising if Doomsday employs a similar strategy in early 2027, once Dune's IMAX exclusivity is over.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: Amazon Has an Asus ROG Flow Z13 Ultra-Portable Gaming Laptop for (Way) Below $2,000
articles.summary: This 2.56 pound convertible is much more powerful than the Xbox Ally X.
articles.body:
Amazon is offering the lowest price I've seen on ASUS' powerful ultraportable gaming convertible. You can pick up a brand new Asus ROG Flow Z13 gaming laptop with 32GB of RAM for just $1,699.99 with free shipping after a $400 off discount. The Asus Flow Z13 (in tablet mode) isn't much bigger or heavier than a handheld gaming PC, but it boasts way better gaming performance that rivals full-sized laptops.

The Asus ROG Flow Z13 Gaming Laptop Drops Below $2,000

Asus ROG Flow Z13 13.4" 2.5K Touch-Screen AMD Ryzen AI Max 390 (Radeon 8050S) Gaming Laptop with 32GB RAM

The Asus ROG Flow Z13 is a 13.4" 2-in-1 convertible laptop that weighs in at only 2.65 pounds. That's about one pound heavier than the Xbox Ally X handheld, which weighs in at 1.6 pounds. A premium laptop deserves premium build quality, and the Flow Z13 doesn't disappoint with a blacked out CNC aluminum alloy chassis and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus screen protection. The Flow Z13 is convertible, the keyboard can be detached so that the Z13 can be used as a tablet.

This particular configuration is equipped with a 13.4" 2560x1600 180Hz IPS display, AMD Ryzen AI Max 390 CPU with AMD Radeon 8050S iGPU, 32GB of LPDDR5X-8000Mhz RAM, and a 1TB SSD. This is less powerful than the highest end ROG Flow Z13, which comes equipped with a Ryzen AI Max 395 CPU with 8060S iGPU, but it's also far less expensive (currently the least expensive model is $2,100 ). The Radeon 8050S is more powerful than the Ryzen Z2 Extreme APU found in the highest-end handheld gaming PCs like the ROG Xbox Ally X.

Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.

articles.title: Adventure Time Is Finally Getting the Full Blu-ray Treatment
articles.summary: The full Adventure Time Blu-ray set is now up for preorder with a release date of October 20, and the best deal is getting it directly through Gruv.
articles.body:
One of the best cartoons of all time is finally getting the full Blu-ray treatment.

Adventure Time originally aired from 2010 and 2018 and quickly became one of the most acclaimed cartoons in history. While all of the individual seasons have been released on Blu-ray, the full series has only been available in a standard DVD format in North America. Until now.

The full Adventure Time Blu-ray set is now up for preorder with a release date of October 20, and the best deal is getting it directly through Gruv .

Adventure Time Blu-ray Releasing October 20

Adventure Time: The Complete Series (Blu-ray)

Pricing currently varies across retailers, with Amazon listing the full set at $89.99 while it’s only $74.99 at Walmart and Gruv. The cheaper price likely has something to do with Gruv being the direct storefront for Warner Bros., the parent company of Cartoon Network. Amazon does offer a preorder pricing guarantee and will likely eventually price-match the other retailers , but for now, why not save a couple of bucks?

While the Amazon listing doesn’t have an image, Walmart and Gruv listings seem to confirm the new release will have the same green packaging as the existing DVD release, just with the Blu-ray logo tacked on the side. Speaking of, IGN did review the Season 1 Blu-ray over a decade ago, claiming "the conversion to Blu is impeccable." I'd imagine this new set will match that colorful quality.

The new set includes all 10 seasons of Adventure Time, a whopping 283 episodes. Instead of the standard DVD with 22 discs, the new Blu-ray set consolidates those episodes down to 12 discs. It also comes with the same spread of bonus features, including:

A retrospective documentary with the cast and crew

A documentary on the music of Adventure Time

We consistently praised all 10 seasons of Adventure Time, and ultimately gave the show’s final episode a perfect 10/10 .

While the original series ended back in 2018, Adventure Time continues to get plenty of love and greenlights. The spin-off series Fionna and Cake ran for two seasons on HBO Max, while a new spin-off, Adventure Time: Side Quests, recently premiered on Hulu and Disney+. An Adventure Time movie is also currently in development at Cartoon Network

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros Trailer Features The Night King on the Iron Throne
articles.summary: Here's a first proper look at gameplay from Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, the upcoming real-time strategy title that lets you conqueror the Seven Kingdoms as one of numerous factions.
articles.body:
Here's a first proper look at gameplay from Game of Thrones: War for Westeros , the upcoming real-time strategy title that lets you conqueror the Seven Kingdoms as one of numerous factions.

Fresh from Gamescom's Opening Night Live broadcast, we have word that Game of Thrones: War for Westeros will launch in early 2027 and have a playable beta before release. More details on exactly when you'll be able to play will follow later this year.

Footage shown today included numerous heroes from the HBO series in action, including Jon Snow, Jaime Lannister, Daenerys Targaryen and the Night King — who ends the trailer sat firmly upon the Iron Throne. Oh dear!

Thankfully you will have your own chance to rewrite Game of Thrones' climactic battle for the Seven Kingdoms as all sorts of factions, and deploy custom units in real-time skirmish battles. A press release accompanying today's reveal also includes mention of Robb Stark, Tywin Lannister and — curiously — both Ghost and Grey Wind.

Alongside direwolves, specific armies will be able to deploy giants, dragons, elephants, and that green fire which destroyed half of King's Landing.

Last month, Game of Thrones: War for Westeros developer PlaySide Studios pushed back the game's release window from 2026 into early 2027 , explaining that the extra breathing room "gives us the time needed to continue building towards that goal and ensure that the game reaches the high level of quality we are aiming for."

"We remain unwavering in our mission to deliver a real-time strategy game set in the world of Westeros that meets the expectations of both RTS players and Game of Thrones fans," PlaySide added. "Thank you for your patience and continued support. We know the wait has been long, and we do not take your support for granted."

Catch up on all of tonight's announcements in our roundup of everything revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 .

Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

articles.title: Exodus Release Date Revealed, the Mass Effect-Like RPG Is Coming in April
articles.summary: Exodus shares plenty of similarities with Mass Effect and seems to be filling the sci-fi RPG void; you won't have to wait long to play it, too.
articles.body:
During gamescom's Opening Night Live , developer Archetype Entertainment revealed the release date for its Mass Effect-like spacefaring RPG: Exodus is launching on April 7, 2027 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. It premiered a new cinematic trailer that showcased new characters and gameplay centered around an intelligent octopus who pilots a mech suit.

Her name is Salt and she is one of several party members you'll gather in Exodus. She is an Awakened, which in the universe of Exodus are hyper-intelligent animals and wildlife who can communicate with humans. Salt will be a long-range sniper who can use an ink smokescreen to provide cover in combat. The trailer hits heavier beats that tease some of its story elements – while Salt gives the main character Jun hard time and tends to be confrontational, she's emotionally driven to protect her species and homeworld.

One of the major hooks of Exodus is the scientific incorporation of time dilation and how it'll affect the story. In true RPG fashion, it'll have player choices that can change outcomes and you'll have a crew to accompany you (a Traveler known as Jun) along the interstallar journey where humanity had to flee Earth and find a new home in the great expanse.

Veteran narrative designer and writer Drew Karpyshyn is the narrative director on Exodus. If you're not familiar, he worked on some of BioWare's most critically acclaimed games serving as senior writer on Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and lead writer on Mass Effect.

Exodus was first revealed during The Game Awards 2023 and made headlines for having famed actor Matthew McCounghey voicing the trailer and playing a character in the game. There was an extended 20-minute gameplay reveal back in June that showcased the action RPG combat, which is very reminescent of Mass Effect with its shooting mechanics and commanding of party member abilities – it also shares a particular sci-fi aesthetic with the BioWare series. Archtype Entertainment has been working under Wizards of the Coast since 2020 and it won't be long until we can finally play what its been working on.

articles.title: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank With Dual USB-C Cables Drops to Just $45.29
articles.summary: Even better, you do not need to be an Amazon Prime member to apply this discount.
articles.body:
If you're heading back to school and you need a high-capacity, high-output power bank at an affordable price, then check out this deal that just went live. Amazon is offering the Baseus Enerfill 25,000mAh 145W Laptop Power Bank for just $45.29 with free shipping after you apply coupon code " 34WHWPWP ".

Even better, you do not need to be an Amazon Prime member . This power bank offers some great quality of life features like dual USB cables that can be combined to form a lanyard, a discrete digital display, and simultaneous charging for up to four devices.

Baseus 25,000mAh 145W Power Bank for $45.29

Baseus Enerfill 25,000mAh 140W Power Bank

The Baseus Enerfill is a slim bar style power bank with a total of four outputs: two integrated USB-C cables that can clip together to form a lanyard, an additional USB-C port, and a USB-A port The USB-C port can output up to 140W if only one is used. That's enough power to charge the newest generation Apple Macbook Pro 16 as well as just about any handheld gaming PC including the new ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X20 . If you use two ports, one output can 100W and the other 45W.

The 25,000mAh capacity can fully recharge your gaming handhelds

This Baseus Enerfill boasts a generous 25,000mAh, or 92.5Whr battery capacity. If you factor in 80% power efficiency, here are the approximate number of times you can fully recharge each gaming handheld or iPhone model:

Nintendo Switch 2 (18Whr) about 4.1 times

Lenovo Legion Go S (55Whr) about 1.3 time

Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max (20Whr) about 3.7 times

This power bank can be brought onto airplanes

You don't need to worry about being stopped at airports. The 25,000mAh 92.5Whr capacity is below TSA's 27,000mAh/100Whr carry-on limit, so you are safely in the clear.

The 20,000mAh version is also on sale for a lower price

Baseus Enerfill 20,000mAh 100W Power Bank

For a limited time, Amazon is offering the Baseus Enerfill 20,000mAh 100W Power Bank for just $33.29 with free shipping after you apply coupon code " RCYRSUYY ". This is a very similar power bank but with a 20,000mAh capacity and 100W of maximum output from the USB-C cable.
